page_title: FIO 3-1 VER | Fiorentina v Verona 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Luca Zufferli pulls out a yellow card.

90+2' 3 - 1 Moise Kean (Fiorentina) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Lorenzo Montipo is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 3:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch so that Edoardo Bove can be given a rest.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch for Andrea Colpani.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Riccardo Sottil.
81' Paolo Zanetti is forced to make a change. Domagoj Bradaric is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Flavius Daniliuc (Verona).
77' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) replaces Yacine Adli.
77' It is time for a substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) is on for Lucas Beltran.
77' The resulting corner, taken by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona), comes to nothing.
75' The game has come to an end for Suat Serdar. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
74' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Darko Lazovic is replaced by Amin Sarr (Verona).

70' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a brilliant save.
70' A tremendous drive by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a brilliant save.
69' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
66' Here is a change. Casper Tengstedt is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
66' Substitution. Tomas Suslov makes his way off the pitch and Reda Belahyane (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
65' Ondrej Duda (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Fiorentina will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
62' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
59' The resulting corner from Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) is cleared by the defence.
59' 2 - 1 Moise Kean (Fiorentina) scores! He finds himself some space inside the box after a cross from the corner kick and blasts the ball into the net. His effort went under the crossbar.
56' Darko Lazovic (Verona) makes a strong challenge and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. Fiorentina are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
54' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Suat Serdar (Verona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
54' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
52' Suat Serdar (Verona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Fiorentina.
50' So close! Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
49' The referee blows his whistle as Moise Kean (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge.
48' Referee Luca Zufferli sees the trip by Dodo (Fiorentina) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Verona.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
43' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Yacine Adli (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
42' Dangerous play by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona). Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
38' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
35' Diego Coppola (Verona) sees a yellow card from Luca Zufferli after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
32' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
31' It looks like Ondrej Duda (Verona) saw red with that tackle. Luca Zufferli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
31' The linesman signals that Darko Lazovic (Verona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
29' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Moise Kean (Fiorentina) heads on.
29' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
28' The game is interrupted now, Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick to Fiorentina.
24' Suat Serdar (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for an infringement. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

24' Tomas Suslov (Verona) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Fiorentina will take a free kick near the side line.

18' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Suat Serdar (Verona) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. David de Gea just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
13' Tomas Suslov (Verona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for an infringement. Fiorentina have a free kick.
12' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is flagged for offside.
11' Darko Lazovic (Verona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
11' Ondrej Duda (Verona) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

10' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
7' Flag goes up against Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

4' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
3' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

2' Luca Zufferli blows for a foul after Abdou Harroui (Verona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Verona will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Luca Zufferli.
